issue.title: Treat a trailing dot parent as the current directory in isWithin
issue.body_html:
Summary

  • isWithin('/dir/.', '/dir/.file') was false because the fast path matched the parent's trailing . against the first character of .file.
  • A lone . component means the current directory, so /dir/. is the same directory as /dir and contains /dir/.file. A name such as .bar is unchanged.
  • Covered with posix cases, and checked the same behavior on the Windows style.

Fixes #537

Test plan

  • Local checks: trailing-dot parent contains .file and file, equals /dir, and foo/./bar is still not a parent of foo/.bar/baz (posix and Windows)
  • dart test test/posix_test.dart --name isWithin inside pkgs/path (pub.dev was unreachable from this environment)

Made with Cursor

Treat a trailing dot parent as the current directory in isWithin.

files.patch:
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 ## 1.9.2-wip
 
+- `isWithin` treats a parent that ends in `/.` as that directory, so
+  `isWithin('/dir/.', '/dir/.file')` is true.
 - Make `Url` style better at recognizing schemes and authorities.
   Only consider a path as being a schemed URL if it starts with a
   valid scheme.

issue.body_html:
import 'package:path/path.dart';

void main(List<String> args) {
  print(isWithin('/dir/.', '/dir/.file'));
  print(isWithin('/dir/.', '/dir/file'));
}

false
true
